note: Real-world scale references for /pokedex/sizes. Each size is the documented figure from its source, in metres; `length` means the figure is a length (measured along its longest side), otherwise a height.

refs.name: Smartphone
refs.fact: An iPhone 16 is 147.6 mm (5.81 in) tall.

refs.name: Adult human
refs.fact: The global mean height of adult men born in 1996 is 171 cm.
refs.source: Our World in Data, Human Height

refs.name: Car
refs.fact: A Toyota Corolla saloon (E210, international) is 4,630 mm long and 1,435 mm tall.

refs.name: School bus
refs.fact: The longest Blue Bird Vision school bus is 499 in (12.67 m) long and up to 128 in (3.25 m) tall.
refs.source: Wikipedia, Blue Bird Vision, citing Blue Bird's specifications

refs.name: Two-storey house
refs.fact: Two storeys at the 3.1 m floor-to-floor height typical of residential buildings.
refs.source: Wikipedia, Storey, citing Saroglou et al. (2017), Energy and Buildings 149

refs.name: 10-storey building
refs.fact: Ten storeys at the 3.1 m floor-to-floor height typical of residential buildings.
refs.source: Wikipedia, Storey, citing Saroglou et al. (2017), Energy and Buildings 149
